state_entry.description: Called when the script enters a state

state_exit.description: Called when the script exits a state

touch_start.description: Called when an avatar starts touching the object

touch.description: Called repeatedly while an avatar is touching the object

touch_end.description: Called when an avatar stops touching the object

on_rez.description: Called when the object is rezzed

changed.description: Called when the object changes (owner, region, inventory, etc.)

timer.description: Called each time the timer fires

body: listen(integer channel, string name, key id, string message)
listen.description: Called when the object hears a chat message on a listened channel

attach.description: Called when the object is attached or detached

dataserver.description: Called when data is received from a dataserver request

run_time_permissions.description: Called when the agent responds to a permission request

sensor.description: Called when the sensor detects objects/agents

no_sensor.description: Called when the sensor detects nothing

collision_start.description: Called when another object starts colliding with this object

collision.description: Called repeatedly while another object is colliding with this object

body: control(key id, integer level, integer edge)
control.description: Called when an agent sends control inputs

money.description: Called when the object receives L$

body: email(string time, string address, string subj, string message, integer num_left)
email.description: Called when the object receives an email

body: http_response(key request_id, integer status, list metadata, string body)
http_response.description: Called when an HTTP response is received

body: at_rot_target(integer tnum, rotation targetrot, rotation ourrot)
at_rot_target.description: Called when the object's rotation is within the rotation target threshold

body: at_target(integer tnum, vector targetpos, vector ourpos)
at_target.description: Called when the object is within the position target threshold

body: http_request(string request_id, string method, string body)
http_request.description: Called when the object receives an HTTP request (URL handler)

land_collision.description: Called repeatedly while the object is colliding with the ground

land_collision_end.description: Called when the object stops colliding with the ground

land_collision_start.description: Called when the object starts colliding with the ground

body: link_message(integer sender_num, integer num, string str, string id)
link_message.description: Called when the script receives a linked message from another script

body: linkset_data(integer action, string name, string value)
linkset_data.description: Called when linkset data is changed

moving_end.description: Called when the object stops moving

moving_start.description: Called when the object starts moving

not_at_rot_target.description: Called when the object is outside its rotation target threshold

not_at_target.description: Called when the object is outside its position target threshold

object_rez.description: Called when this object rezzes another object

region_cross.description: Called when the object crosses a region boundary

body: remote_data(integer event_type, string channel, string message_id, string sender, integer idata, string sdata)
remote_data.description: Called when an XML-RPC message is received

body: transaction_result(string id, integer success, string data)
transaction_result.description: Called when a transaction (e.g. llManageEstateAccess) completes
